$comment: Default judge policy: a screener (Claude Sonnet 5 through Claude Code; use full model ids, the `haiku`/`sonnet` aliases resolve on their own) judges every case; a case the screener does not PASS, or PASSes while listing a major issue, is confirmed by Codex on GPT-6-Luna. Override per run with --policy / --backend / --model / --screen-model / --confirm-model. Mode: "visual" (default) judges the texts plus the render capture (eval/render/out/<slug>/, made by `pnpm --filter @read/eval render`), at most maxImages tiles per call; "text" (--mode text) judges SOURCE and EXTRACTED only.
